messages:
patricia_pm: Heads-up: Finance asked for a single-page Console view that ties "cost by feature" to SLO breaches and deploy markers for their QBR. They want a clean slide export they can hand to procurement. Can we scope an MVP and clear launch gates?

omar_backend: Minimal approach: require customer-provided feature->route mapping for beta. Ingest changes: route_id, tokens_in/out, model_id, price_snapshot_id annotated at ingress. Keep sampling off by default.

lee_ui: UX suggestion: Landing card with feature selector, stacked cost bars (token cost vs infra), SLO breach dots, and an "Export slide" button that renders a one-page PDF summarizing causes for cost spikes.

sree_infra: Operational constraints: on-demand trace fetch only; per-org quota and rate-limit. Auto-disable sampling if any host CPU delta > 3% for two consecutive 5m windows. telemetry flags required.

ops-bot: Flag created: finance_slo_onepage_beta. Alert created: "telemetry_ingest_cpu_delta" threshold 3%, notify #eng-oncall and #eng-platform.

claire_sales: Key ask from the customer (Tidewater): they need the export to show: cost/day, error-rate/day, p95 latency, and an explanation column that attributes spike to token delta vs model price change vs traffic.

omar_backend: Calculation: cost_usd = sum((tokens_in + tokens_out) * unit_price_at_ingest). We'll annotate each event with price_snapshot_id to avoid joins at query time. We'll keep retention for price metadata 90d.

lee_ui: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Customer can filter by feature list and see cost/day, error-rate/day, p95 latency for last 30 days
- Selecting a spike opens a micro-overlay: token delta / model price delta / volume change breakdown
- Export button produces CSV + one-page PDF that includes up to 3 sampled traces (on-demand, counts against quota)
- Performance: enabling route tags causes <1% median tail request latency increase

sree_infra: Rollout plan:
- Phase A: feature->route mapping + ingress price_annotation + aggregated cost panels (no traces stored)
- Phase B: on-demand trace fetch with per-org quota + 30d TTL compressed storage
- Phase C: automated correlation alerts and forecasting (future)

patricia_pm: Risks to call out:
- customers forget to provide accurate mapping -> noisy results
- trace storage costs if abused
- reconciliation headaches when price snapshots change mid-window

omar_backend: Mitigations:
- require mapping CSV for beta and provide a template
- quota + rate-limits + auto-throttle + compression + 30d TTL
- price_snapshot_id at ingest and documentation for finance reconciliation

lee_ui: CSV export columns for MVP: feature, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, price_snapshot_id, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, errors_count, p95_latency_ms. PDF export auto-generates a chart + explanatory bullets.

sree_infra: I'll own alerts & auto-disable playbook. If telemetry_ingest_cpu_delta fires, sampling auto-disabled and #eng-oncall paged. Ops-bot: please ensure the flag can be auto-rolled back.

ops-bot: Confirmed: flag supports auto-disable and rollback hooks. Runbook entry created.

claire_sales: Tidewater timeline: needs beta demo in 6 weeks for procurement. Realistic?

omar_backend: Phase A in 6 weeks if Tidewater provides mapping and we reprioritize a sprint. Phase B likely Q3.

patricia_pm: Owners matrix:
- Product: patricia_pm (Tidewater liaison + acceptance)
- Backend: omar_backend (ingest + price snapshot + materialized views)
- UI: lee_ui (cards + export + micro-overlay)
- Infra/SRE: sree_infra (quotas, alerts, rollback)
- Flags/Automation: ops-bot (feature flag + runbook)

lee_ui: Action items: I'll upload mockups for landing card and export template by EOW. Include microcopy for "why cost rose".

omar_backend: I'll draft the ingestion PR that adds price_snapshot_id and a daily materialized table for cost per feature by date.

sree_infra: I'll draft quota policy and run storage cost estimate for 1k trace pulls/day across 50 beta orgs.

patricia_pm: Decision: greenlight Phase A gated beta for Tidewater if they submit mapping CSV. Phase B to follow after perf signoff and budget. I'll add this to the roadmap and notify stakeholders.

claire_sales: I'll follow up with Tidewater for the mapping and legal note on trace retention.

patricia_pm: Thanks everyone. Closing thread; will post acceptance script once mockups are in. :white_check_mark:
